It is a part of the [[CK Birla Group|CKA Birla Group]].{{cite news |last1=Arakali |first1=Harichandan |title=From Mphasis to WNS, four midcaps changing the Indian IT game |url=https://www.forbesindia.com/article/it-services-special-2023/from-mphasis-to-wns-four-midcaps-changing-the-indian-it-game/84347/1 |work=[[Forbes India]] |date=April 12, 2023}}{{cite news |last1=Parmar |first1=Beena |title=Birlasoft eyes large clients to lead industry growth |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/information-tech/birlasoft-eyes-large-clients-to-lead-industry-growth/articleshow/108146072.cms |work=[[The Economic Times]] |date=March 4, 2024}} Birlasoft has a presence in the [[United States]], [[United Kingdom]], [[Europe]], and the [[Asia–Pacific|Asia-Pacific]] region and delivery centers in [[India]].{{cite news |last1=Warrier |first1=Shobha |title=Birlasoft opens development centre in Chennai |url=https://www.rediff.com/money/2003/aug/07birlasoft.htm |work=[[Rediff.com]] |date=August 7, 2003}} The company's shares are listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and the [[National Stock Exchange of India]]. As of April 2024, Birlasoft's market capitalization was approximately ₹20,000 crore.{{cite news |last1=Balachandran |first1=Manu |title=Long-term wealth creation calls for long-term investments: Ravi Pandit |url=https://www.forbesindia.com/article/billionaires/longterm-wealth-creation-calls-for-longterm-investments-ravi-pandit/92835/1 |work=[[Forbes India]] |date=April 30, 2024}} == History == Birlasoft was founded in 1990. The company was launched in [[New Jersey]] in 1992 with initial equity investment from [[GE Capital]]. By the fiscal year 2002-2003, the company reported $73 million in revenue and 1,500 employees. In 2003, GE Capital held a 20% equity stake in the company.{{cite news |title=BIRLASOFT: Reversing the Order |url=https://www.dqindia.com/birlasoft-reversing-the-order/ |publisher=[[Dataquest]] |date=August 25, 2003}}{{cite news |title=BirlaSoft Under Pressure |url=https://www.dqindia.com/r-n-r-nbirlasoft-under-pressure-r-n-r-n/ |publisher=[[Dataquest]] |date=August 31, 2000}}{{cite news |title=Birlasoft, iPlanet in service pact |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/birlasoft-iplanet-in-service-pact/articleshow/12965649.cms |work=[[The Times of India]] |date=December 21, 2000}} In 2001, Birlasoft secured a contract from the [[Ministry of External Affairs of India]] to computerize Indian consulates in [[New York City|New York]] and [[Dubai]], with an extension to 38 other consulates worldwide.{{cite news |title=BIRLASOFT: Back on Track |url=https://www.dqindia.com/41-birlasoft-back-on-track-1/ |publisher=[[Dataquest]] |date=August 4, 2001}} In April 2004, the company achieved a Level 5 maturity in CMMI Continuous Representation - SW version 1.1 from the [[Software Engineering Institute]], becoming the first Indian IT company to attain this level.{{cite news |title=Birlasoft gets CMMI Level 5 appraisal |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/focus/it-cities/delhi/birlasoft-gets-cmmi-level-5-appraisal/articleshow/621728.cms |work=[[The Economic Times]] |date=April 16, 2004}} In December 2005, Birlasoft acquired Portfolio Insight, a loan pricing and portfolio management software, from [[Sydney]]-based Fusion Technology Group.{{cite news |last1=Kant |first1=Krishna |title=Birlasoft eyes acquisitions in ERP space |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/newet/emerging-business-it/birlasoft-eyes-acquisitions-in-erp-space/articleshow/1344582.cms |work=[[The Economic Times]] |date=December 24, 2005}} The company launched Birlasoft Advisior+ in the Asia-Pacific market in 2006, providing tools for investment advisors and financial institutions for portfolio management and analytics.{{cite news |title=Birlasoft launches ADVISIOR+ for wealth managers |url=https://www.oneindia.com/2006/08/30/birlasoft-launches-advisior-for-wealth-managers-1156934312.html |publisher=[[One India]] |date=August 30, 2006}} In January 2014, Birlasoft acquired US-based [[CRM software]] provider EnablePath for an undisclosed sum.{{cite news |last1=Gupta |first1=Bhavna |last2=Puthuparampil Johnson|first2=Joby |title=Birlasoft acquires US-based CRM solutions provider EnablePath |url=https://www.vccircle.com/birlasoft-acquires-us-based-crm-solutions-provider-enablepath |publisher=[[VCCircle]] |date=January 9, 2014}} In 2019, Birlasoft and [[KPIT Technologies]] underwent a merger and demerger, leading to the creation of two publicly traded companies, with Birlasoft operating in business IT services and KPIT Technologies focusing on automotive embedded software.{{cite news |last1=Phadnis |first1=Shilpa |title=KPIT to merge with Birlasoft, split into two |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/kpit-to-merge-with-birlasoft-split-into-two/articleshow/62703494.cms |work=[[The Times of India]] |date=January 30, 2018}}{{cite news |last1=Mendonca |first1=Jochelle |title=KPIT, Birlasoft to merge and split into two publicly-traded companies extract:
Birlasoft is an Indian multinational information technology services and consulting company, founded in 1990 and headquartered in Pune, India. It is a part of the CKA Birla Group.
Birlasoft has a presence in the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region and delivery centers in India.
The company's shares are listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange of India. As of April 2024, Birlasoft's market capitalization was approximately ₹20,000 crore.
